single_hypothesis: Replacing the STFT/ISTFT separator with a no-downsampling dilated time-domain complex residual network preserves local ISRJ phase-reset boundaries and transfers the P2x width estimator across ID and OOD intervals.

failure_basis.P2x: exact-component phase-reset width estimation passed all five ID/OOD regimes
failure_basis.P2y: the frozen shared STFT U-Net retained waveform cosine but not width ordering
failure_basis.P2z: dedicated STFT U-Net reached waveform cosine 0.56-0.77; reset loss changed mean width MAE by -0.016 percent and Pearson remained near zero
failure_basis.inference: sample-local phase discontinuities are blurred by STFT/ISTFT and frequency-mask reconstruction; another reset-loss weight search is not justified

data.training_root: reuse frozen P2z train-only seed3700000000 ID-control roles
data.training_roles: same fixed 6/2/2 identities per combination as P2z

candidate.name: TD-Reset
candidate.architecture: 2-channel stem plus six no-downsampling depthwise-separable residual blocks
candidate.output: sample-domain complex residual plus identity skip, followed by complex RMS normalization
candidate.loss: same P2z waveform objective plus fixed 0.5 phase-curvature consistency

comparators.C0_raw: P2x estimator on raw compound I/Q
comparators.C1_frozen_P2z_STFT_Reset: frozen seed-matched P2z S1 checkpoint evaluated without tuning on seed400

stop_rule: No architecture, loss, threshold or epoch tuning on seed400. If P3a fails an absolute physical gate, stop learned ISRJ waveform-separator development and retain P2x as oracle/identifiability evidence only. If it passes, freeze all weights and run two fresh identity seeds before any full-system attachment.
